That's got it. I selected the first two cards, opened "Reading," chose "Mark unread," and both of them turned up in Read later — the same bookmarks moved there, not duplicates. And it's clear the control works both ways: unread adds a batch to the read-later pile, read clears a batch off it, both spelled out plainly under "Reading" just like the labels are under "Labels." That completes the reverse-actions I was after — read/unread and add/remove label all now work on a batch in both directions. The bulk tidying-up side feels whole to me now.

That closes out everything I raised around selecting and acting on many at once. Thanks for working through each piece.
